# Altitude Climber

> Himachal Tourism certified Himalayan trek and tour operator based in Kalont, Jaon (Kullu district), Himachal Pradesh, India. Run by head guide Rakesh Kumar. Tagline: "Hidden Trails, Bigger Stories".

- Official website: https://altitudeclimber.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88940 97718
- Email: altitudeclimber.team@gmail.com
- Address: Village Kalont, P.O. Jaon, Tehsil Nirmand, District Kullu, Himachal Pradesh 172002
- Hours: Monday – Sunday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/altitude_climber_69
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/18hkNTNvpL/

Prices and availability are confirmed by the team on request; routes marked "suggested" are proposals confirmed before booking.
